sentences.en: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
sentences.zh: 偶数乘以奇数是偶数，奇数乘以奇数是奇数。

sentences.en: She carries on smiling even in the face of adversity.
sentences.zh: 即使面对逆境，她仍然面带微笑。

sentences.en: We cannot do without salt even for a single day.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至一天都离不开盐。
